name: Emergency locksmith
summary: How expats handle lockouts and lock changes in Singapore — 24-hour callouts, condo access rules, landlord consent, and avoiding overpriced middle-of-night scams.
body:
Emergency locksmiths open jammed doors, replace cylinders after break-ins, and cut restricted keys when mall booths cannot help. Condos add MCST/guard protocols that a street locksmith may not bypass alone.

## Typical jobs
- Night lockouts with keys inside / broken in cylinder
- Non-destructive entry vs drill-and-replace decisions
- Cylinder upgrades after lost keys or helper turnover
- Mailbox and padlock emergencies
- Safe opening referrals (specialist)

Always confirm tenancy and landlord rules before changing a main door lock permanently.

## How to choose
Ask for a capped call-out quote before they travel. Prefer firms that state non-destructive attempt first. Verify company name against the van and receipt. Guards may need owner authorisation — keep managing-agent numbers handy.

## Practical tip
Store a trusted neighbour or agent spare before you need one. Photograph lock brand/model now so a midnight call describes the cylinder accurately.
whenToEngage: Locked out overnight or after hours
Need cylinder change after lost keys / turnover
Condo guard / MCST access rules unclear
Comparing non-destructive entry vs drill quotes
